fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reports on Greater Miami business anxiety over a poor winter season and persistent vacancies in hotels and apartments; criticism of the Miami Herald for allegedly cheating classified advertisers by narrowing column width and type size; discussion of Salvation Army controversy and a response letter from Salvation Army City Commander Richard T. Bergren; commentary on Miami Beach gas company service and regulation; local civic notes on traffic control, garbage collection, and crime with municipal court fine statistics; labor dispute coverage criticizing columnist Paul Bruun; and a feature article arguing that tobacco smoke and industrial tars cause cancer and emphasizing prevention.
